title: Stack Update Receipt
description: stack-update/v1 (ADR-086 D5). The single, machine-global receipt written by hooks/stack-self-update.sh and hooks/stack-update-apply.sh at <conf>/state/stack-update/receipt.json. Only trustworthy because that path is denyWrite-protected (ADR-086 D17) -- a model-writable receipt could forge status:current, the exact lie ADR-085 exists to prevent.

schema.description: Schema identifier and version tag. Always the literal string stack-update/v1.

hook_version.description: The revision of ADR-086 that wrote this receipt. Rev 3 ships 3.

as_of.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp of the run that produced this receipt. If older than 12h, the hook did not run this boot (ADR-085 couldn't-look).

status.description: Closed, eight-value vocabulary (ADR-086 D5). No ninth value without an ADR.

reason.description: Required (non-null) whenever status is skipped|blocked|failed. Closed, 28-value vocabulary. status-unknown: `git status` itself failed, so cleanliness could not be determined -- distinct from `dirty`, because 'could not look' must never be recorded as 'looked and it was fine' (ADR-085's rule). operation-in-progress: an unfinished merge, cherry-pick, revert or rebase is present; the tree can be clean while the repository is mid-operation, and a fast-forward would fail.

session_id.description: From the hook payload. Debugging only.

remote_url.description: The pin's remote_url, echoed for display.

branch.description: HEAD of the source repo at probe time.

staged_sha.description: The fetched tip, full 40-hex. The integrity anchor for staging (ADR-086 D13).

staged_subjects.description: Up to 5 commit subjects, each sanitized per D19 and truncated to 100 chars.

error.description: Sanitized per D19 at write time. Never an empty string on the dev face.

needs_human.description: true iff status==failed or reason in {dirty, branch, detached, no-upstream, not-ff, partial, pin-mismatch, remote-mismatch, stuck}.

fail_sha.description: The staged_sha that last failed to apply (D20).

retry_after.description: Staging is skipped for fail_sha until this time (D20).

deadline_degraded.description: true when no process-group kill tool (setsid/perl) was available (D18).
